plugins.name: pavlo-skills
plugins.description: All of Pavlo's reusable AI coding agent skills (ticket writing, planning, execution, commit rewriting, PR descriptions, and more). Root plugin — skills/ is unchanged so npx skills keeps working.

plugins.name: pavlo-hooks
plugins.description: Pavlo's Claude Code hooks. Includes a reformat-guard PostToolUse hook that reminds the model to scope reformatting to only the changed functions.

plugins.name: pavlo-toolkit
plugins.description: Meta-plugin that installs everything — pulls in pavlo-skills and pavlo-hooks as dependencies. Install this to get the complete setup.
